capture_scope: Static localStorage/sessionStorage getItem/setItem/removeItem calls whose first argument is a quoted literal. Dynamic-key constructors inventoried separately. No browser/WebView QA.

literal_key_classes.privacy_review: Random transient nonce and issued-at timestamp only; does not contain user ID, payment status, identity, receipt, or access token. Checkout consumes it only for the same-tab return decision within 10 minutes. Browser history can still evict Course; fallback full reload is safe. Account-switch and stale-token QA pending.

dynamic_key_contracts.privacy_review: Cache is namespaced by localUserScope to avoid cross-account reuse; in-flight reads reject if scope changes. Client identity is not server authorization; runtime switching QA remains required.
Seven-day resume cursor is namespaced by localUserScope for signed Telegram users; unauthenticated preview keeps the legacy non-account key. Old shared account cursor is not migrated.
localUserScope uses tg.initDataUnsafe user id; live cross-user QA required
uses explicit Telegram userId suffix instead of localUserScope; do not infer identity-free behavior from absence of helper
Signed Telegram user id scopes mastery; unauthenticated preview retains the existing hsk_memo key. Old shared account state is not migrated.

Old Telegram global UI-only preference stays compatible. PWA preference uses localUserScope() which derives from the server verified PWA session, not initDataUnsafe; runtime account switch still needs QA.

risks.scope: tg.initDataUnsafe is unverified client data; server entitlement cannot rely on it

limitations: Source key inventory only. Does not prove data leak, browser origin shared between Telegram sessions, user authorization, expiry behavior, race conditions, or existing device artifacts; no sensitive contents or user identifiers emitted.

pwa_dynamic_storage_review.reason: PWA branch moves mistake access_ref removal from a quoted literal to a user-scoped ternary and moves memorize preference from a quoted literal to memoPrefKey(). Neither is a dropped operation; both require explicit source guard and identity-switch QA. PWA course logout also clears the pre-existing Telegram link request id from the same-tab session store; this explicit cleanup is separately classified. Verified iPhone checkout return nonce uses a new explicit sessionStorage literal, now classified; no learner data or entitlement is stored.
